obstacle: Generalization of conditional real RF link predictions remains poor after rich source fitting, free drift and bounded training-only GCV; strongest simple baseline must be beaten.

acceptance.primary: 300-second pooled phase RMS <= .9 times the strongest direct primary value on 874 fixed pairs
acceptance.secondary: Both code RMS values and 30-second phase RMS <=1.02 times their metric-wise best direct values.
acceptance.fold_rule: At least four of five improve primary phase RMS versus the single globally chosen best-primary direct method; no fold >10% worse.
acceptance.counts_and_unknowns: Retain every original terminal, all unavailable and worsening cases; no support cherry-picking.
acceptance.scope: Practical exploratory predictive criteria, not physical accuracy, source identifiability, population significance or blind confirmation.

discovery.path: Reuse existing Provider, PublicGitHub and Service/Budget/Store primitives and the already used experiment-local invocation; no new runner or intake feature.
discovery.initial_target_files: Operator-selected, explicitly truncated excerpts; no autonomous target-file selection claim.

native_adaptation.scope: Existing native reference prediction path only, no new RF orbit fit, new source-truth injection, acquisition, target state or new generalized validation infrastructure.

budget.authorization: not granted; #130 allowance is closed and cannot be reused

execution_gate: Distinct user cap approval plus preparation review and Windows/Linux CI green. No further direct comparator tuning or donor search before that decision.
limitations: Previously exposed archive, including the operator already observing baseline held scores.
Shared folds and data, not five independent replications.
Local demand and operator excerpts, not a blocked-agent checkpoint.
Numerical GCV is one direct predictive comparison with declared assumptions, not exhaustion of direct solvers.
